commands.help: Returns the summarized data for the given metric from the given namespace.

options.name: --namespace-name
options.help: The source service or application to use when searching for metric data points to aggregate.

options.name: --metric-name
options.help: The name of a metric for retrieving aggregated data.

options.name: --compartment-id
options.help: The OCID of the compartment to use for authorization to read metrics.

options.name: --dimensions
options.help: Qualifiers to use when searching for metric data.

options.name: --start-time
options.help: The beginning of the sampled time range to use when searching for metric data points.

options.name: --end-time
options.help: The end of the sampled time range to use when searching for metric data points.

commands.help: Returns a list of available metrics for the given namespace.

options.name: --namespace-name
options.help: The name of the source service emitting the metric.

options.name: --compartment-id
options.help: The OCID of the compartment to use for authorization.

options.name: --page-size
options.help: When fetching results, the number of results to fetch per call.

commands.help: List all the available source services called namespaces emitting metrics for this region.

options.help: The OCID of the compartment to use for authorization.
